title: Find Slope from Tables and Points Core Test
description: Calculate slope from tables and coordinate pairs using change in y over change in x.

questions.questionText: The table shows points (0, -2), (2, -1), and (4, 0). What is the slope?
questions.explanation: In a linear table, the slope is the same for every pair of rows: change in y divided by change in x.
